raw_snippet: CoreWeave today announced a deal to deliver AI infrastructure to OpenAI, expanding OpenAI's compute capacity for training and delivering its latest models at scale to its hundreds of millions of users around the world. The contract value for this strategic deal is up to $11.9 billion.
note: CoreWeave -> OpenAI reserved-capacity master services agreement (signed 7 Mar 2025), up to US$11.9B through Oct 2030; "up to" at face. S-1/A of 12 Mar 2025 confirms.

raw_snippet: OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to $4.0 billion through April 2029 related to this agreement
note: CoreWeave -> OpenAI second master services agreement (dated 8 May 2025), up to US$4.0B through Apr 2029; "up to" at face. First disclosed in the Q1 2025 10-Q.

raw_snippet: OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to approximately $6.5 billion through May 31, 2031 under the Order Form
note: CoreWeave -> OpenAI order form (signed 23 Sep 2025) under the May 2025 MSA, up to US$6.5B through May 2031; brings the three OpenAI deals to ~US$22.4B. CoreWeave 8-K Item 1.01.
